To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the speech perception in the noise is better when the CI is placed in the right side.
the speech perception in the noise of adults with cochlear implant was better in the frontal than in the lateral position.
the use of the CI in the noise condition, with different positions in the noise, was effective for the speech perception in quiet condition.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of speech perception in noise, in adults implanted with cochlear implants, at different positions.
the speech perception in the presence of noise in adults with cochlear implants at different positions.
the evaluation of the Speech Perception at different positions in the noise in adults with cochlear implant.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, the speech perception in noise is a complex process that involves the central auditory system.
, in the present study, the Speech Perception in Noise Test (SIN) was able to detect a difference between the performance of the participants in the two positions tested.
the Speech Perception in Noise (SPN) is an important tool for evaluating the auditory rehabilitation of the cochlear implant user.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated that the position of the listener is an important factor for the perception of speech.

the Speech Perception in Noise Test (SPIN) has a high level of correlation with the Speech, Spatial, and Qualities (SSQ) test, and both are sensitive to the different positions of the head of adults with cochlear implant (CI).

the results of the speech perception tests in noise in adults with cochlear implant, when compared to the normal hearing group, showed significant differences in the speech perception in the noise at different positions, in all the tests, with the exception of the speech perception in noise test at 90º in the right ear.
The main takeaway from our work is that
speech perception in noise is a complex task and it is not enough to measure the perception at one position, but it is necessary to measure the perception in the three positions.

the use of the Spondees in Noise Test (SN) in adults with cochlear implant, is a good alternative for evaluating speech perception in noise, and it has the advantage of being a simple and fast procedure.

the use of speech perception test in the noise is important to the clinical evaluation of the speech perception in adults with cochlear implant, since this test allows the evaluation in the most natural condition of the hearing.
